Carrot Powder Price: Spray Dried Carrot Powder for Food Manufacturers

Comparing carrot powder price offers and want a supplier you can rely on? Tradenest Naturals produces spray dried carrot powder for food, beverage and supplement manufacturers around the world. The powder is made by spray drying fresh carrot juice and pulp into a fine, bright orange powder. It keeps the natural color and mild sweet taste of carrots. As a carrot powder manufacturer, we work to a fixed specification on every batch.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Carrot Powder?

Consistency is what most food manufacturers ask for first. We deliver a standard product that fits into your formulation the same way each time. Our spray dried carrot powder manufacturer process uses controlled drying conditions. This helps the beta-carotene pigment keep its natural orange shade. Your finished products keep an even color from run to run. We act as a carrot powder supplier for snack makers, soup and sauce producers and supplement brands.

Advanced Manufacturing Process

Ripe carrots are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. They are washed, trimmed and prepared to remove soil and damaged pieces. The prepared carrot liquid is then atomized into fine droplets inside the spray dryer. Water evaporates quickly and leaves uniform, soluble particles. Thanks to this method, our bulk spray dried carrot powder disperses well in water and dry mixes. In sealed packs it offers a shelf life of 18-24 months. As a carrot powder exporter, we keep our process efficient and our packing export-ready.

Versatile Industrial Applications

The powder has many uses. Food technologists use it to add color to soups, sauces and gravies. Bakers use it in muffins, cakes and breads. Beverage makers add it to juices and smoothies as a coloring ingredient. Supplement brands buy dehydrated carrot powder wholesale for vegetable powder blends. Whether you need spray dried carrot powder bulk for seasonings or for color, we can supply regular volumes.

Technical Specifications and Quality Assurance

Technical precision matters on your production line. We control moisture at 5% or below and keep particle size at 80-100 mesh. Our carrot powder bulk price reflects careful raw material selection and steady processing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. If you are looking for a dehydrated carrot powder wholesale partner, our team is ready to help.
